tasks.label: inspect reservation weekdays
tasks.command: node -e "import('@libsql/client').then(async ({createClient})=>{const db=createClient({url:'file:local.db'}); const r=await db.execute('select room, weekday, start_minute, end_minute from room_availabilities order by room, weekday'); console.log(JSON.stringify(r.rows,null,2));})"
